policy: Every listed capability is a required release gate. No capability may be downgraded to optional.

capabilities.implementation: Versioned Zod architecture model and partial validators exist; no Casa source instance or full constraint solver.
The deterministic validator audits same-level room overlap, room-door boundary contact, door-connected room paths, exterior exits, and source-area deltas; no real Casa trace has passed it yet.
gates: every room reaches a modeled exterior exit

capabilities.implementation: No parametric section-plane renderer exists for Casa.
gates: all three modes tested without changing geometry

capabilities.implementation: The existing T3 view has wall/furniture/label controls, Sun/Rooms/Fixtures focus, perspective/top-down/reset, and solar controls; Casa's validated-room parity is not yet integrated.
A local Street View MCP captures metadata/images and meters calls; it does not yet create reviewed, georeferenced same-block home footprints.
gates: hard stop at 10 MCP image calls before user notice
